note: Stage L1 vectors. contributions.a is the phase-1c vector contribution (fork-a, snap-a); the other contribution IDs, evidence digests and verdict digests are synthetic; the policy digest is the SHA-256 of Lara examples/S4/ord-setting-v1.policy.lara at a31299f; native identities reuse snap-a and snap-c from ../vectors.json. Expected IDs were computed by lara_identity.py when the contracts were frozen.

files.argument_a:
# Contract-vector argument (fork-a). Header and claims follow Lara examples/S2 and S4;
# the body is abbreviated and is not a checked program.
artifact ord_setting_demo at sha256:4e76e27e5716d33f20dd68387a2e7576aaf6d6bce82156b69d7abed0e804f28e
policy ord-setting-v1
use backends [ord@1]

claim c1
  nl      = "sys_new outperforms sys_base on ImageNet-val accuracy (0.74 vs 0.71)"
  formal  = better(sys_new, sys_base, accuracy, imagenet_val)
  binding = { author = alice, rationale = "Ordered comparison of two reported accuracy cells.", audit-status = reviewed }
files.argument_c:
# Contract-vector argument (fork-c); abbreviated, not a checked program.
artifact ord_setting_demo_c at sha256:9f0933fdeafd0d802723560bf09bd24b5ee7d229ac07ad9a8b063f96e18e262f
policy ord-setting-v1
use backends [ord@1]

claim c_neg
  formal  = not_better(sys_new, sys_base, accuracy, imagenet_val)
  binding = { author = carol, audit-status = unreviewed }
